scope: Isolated metre floor/grid, actual latest production CharacterBody3D/avatar/exploration camera and engine Input actions. Independent late physics/process recorder captures local joint transforms and visible-root/eye histories at 30/60Hz physics and 30/60/144 render caps. Explicit placements, native walls/parapet/new-obstacle/recovery faults and fixed facility pose are test-only. Actual observed render fractions are used without assigning production render fraction. Images use the ordinary production exploration Camera3D. No city actors, persistent settings, source geometry, OS keyboard, sustained FPS, real anthropometry/photorealism or subjective comfort claim.
